lp.f_att_d: Present, absent and late in a few taps, monthly reports and attendance percentage on every profile.
lp.f_classes_d: Grades, Hifz levels, sections and a subject catalogue that teachers and exams all share.
lp.f_exams_d: Marks entry by subject or as a grid, GPA on the standard 4.00 or Bangladesh 5.00 scale, published result cards.

lp.f_teachers_d: Teacher accounts, subject assignments and printable login slips for staff and students.
lp.faq_1_a: No. Install it on a computer or a school network and use it from a browser. The app ships its own CSS, fonts and scripts, with no external services required.
lp.faq_1_q: Do I need the internet to use it?
lp.faq_2_a: Yes. Administrators see everything. Teachers only see the classes they teach. Students only see their own results, attendance, fees and routine. The server enforces this on every request.
lp.faq_2_q: Can teachers and students have their own logins?
lp.faq_3_a: Yes. English, Bangla and Arabic are built in, and Arabic uses a right-to-left layout. You can add another language and type your own translations in Settings.
lp.faq_3_q: Does it work in Bangla or Arabic?
lp.faq_4_a: Yes. Settings > Branding sets the name, logo and colours, which then apply across the app, the landing page and printouts.
lp.faq_4_q: Can I use our school name, logo and colours?
lp.faq_5_a: The login page shows a Demo sign-in box with an administrator, a teacher and a student account (no special start flag). For a sample school that resets on every restart, use start-demo.bat. On a real school set DEMO_LOGINS=false. You can also take the product tour without signing in.
lp.faq_5_q: What is in the live demo?
lp.faq_6_a: Yes. Starting a new version keeps the data folder and runs any new database migrations automatically, after saving a backup copy.
lp.faq_6_q: Will it keep our existing records if we upgrade?
lp.features_sub: Built with madrasas and schools: Hifz and general classes, Bangladesh and standard grading, Saturday-to-Thursday weeks.
lp.features_title: Everything a school office needs, nothing it does not
